# name script

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:nameScript`](gmeow-nameScript.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/nameScript>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)

The ISO 15924 script code of an appellation (e.g. "Hani", "Arab", "Latn"). Available explicitly for indexing alongside a BCP-47 script subtag on the literal.
